chunks: He was asked about a sick person who is unable to sit: may he pray while lying down and place something on his forehead?
So he said: "Yes. Allah has not burdened him except to his capacity."

key_terms.الْجُلُوسَ: sitting, the normal posture that the person is unable to perform
key_terms.الْمَرِيضِ: the sick person whose condition affects performance of salat (prayer)
key_terms.جَبْهَتِهِ: his forehead, the place referenced for placement during prostration-related action
key_terms.طَاقَتَهُ: his capacity or ability, the measure of legal responsibility
key_terms.مُضْطَجِعٌ: lying down, the permitted prayer posture in case of incapacity

ai.seo_question: Can a sick person pray while lying down if they are unable to sit?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for a sick person who cannot sit for salat (prayer). It permits praying while lying down, affirming that Allah does not obligate a person beyond their ability.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1034 - It was asked about a sick person who is unable to sit—whether they can pray while lying down and placing something on their forehead.
Imam (as) replied: "Yes, Allah (swt) has not burdened them beyond their capacity."
